trailhead.label: The village centre of Algund, the board’s start

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
Crosses the old Vinschgau state road, which has little traffic: lead short while crossing.
Steps up from the Alperia power station to the old state road.
Access roads to Josefsberg and road 9 are tarred and open to cars: lead on.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
